digest.component_or_area: test reliability oracles: subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted consumes 15+ seconds due to production-scale 10s low-speed window and 15s loopback server; contract requires only throughput above floor through one complete window, not absolute elapsed time

test_read_retried_then_terminal consumes ~9 seconds due to 1s per-attempt deadline plus real 2s/4s retry sleeps across three processes; contract requires exactly three attempts, exact logical retry schedule, and confirmed process cleanup, not nine elapsed seconds

injected sub-second test windows (1s low-speed, 0.1s call/grace/drain) with real socket/process execution and logical backoff recording must satisfy all assertions while reducing wall time to single-digit seconds
every child PID spawned by ACLI read sentinel must be confirmed absent after terminal failure via polling, proving no process group survives
production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, backoff defaults and _MAX_ATTEMPTS count must remain unchanged
